name: JACKKNIFE
source:
A psychological horror visual novel set in the highways of rural America. You play a lone hitchhiker trying to outrun your past when a charming truck driver named Jackie offers you a ride. But as snow begins to fall, you sense that your rescuer might be far more dangerous than you expected.

[Edited from [url=https://llonelly.itch.io/jackknife]itch.io[/url]]
